rationale: Absolute ceiling (Story 3.4, AC 5): freeze ~2.5 KB above the 92,498 B gz measured after Story 3.3 as the NFR-2 regression stop. NOT derived from the slow-3G TTI budget — at ~50 KB/s that math cannot produce a ceiling this bundle already satisfies (see docs/k6-latency-signoff.md, TTI section). Raising this number is a deliberate PR decision; the check script has no --update shortcut by design.
